intro x
  have : x ∈ s ∩ t ∪ s ∩ u := by
    cases x ∈ s ∩ t ∪ s ∩ u with
    | inl (x ∈ s ∩ t) => exact ⟨x, by { rw ← ∩_def; exact ⟨x ∈ s, x ∈ t⟩; }, by { rw ← ∪_def; exact ⟨x ∈ s ∩ t, by { rw ← ∩_def; exact ⟨x ∈ s, x ∈ t⟩⟩⟩⟩ }⟩
    | inr (x ∈ s ∩ u) => exact ⟨x, by { rw ← ∩_def; exact ⟨x ∈ s, x ∈ u⟩; }, by { rw ← ∪_def; exact ⟨x ∈ s ∩ u, by { rw ← ∩_def; exact ⟨x ∈ s, x ∈ u⟩⟩⟩⟩ }
  have : x ∈ s ∩ (t ∪ u) := by
    rw ← ∩_def
    rw ← ∪_def
    apply ∧.intro
    apply ∧.intro
    apply ∧.elim
    apply ∧.elim
    apply ∧.elim
    apply ∧.elim
    exact ⟨x ∈ s, by { rw ← ∩_def; exact ⟨x ∈ s, by { rw ← ∩_def; exact ⟨x ∈ s, by { rw ← ∩_def; exact ⟨x ∈ s, by { rw ← ∩_def; exact ⟨x ∈ s, by { rw ← ∩_def; exact ⟨x ∈ s, by { rw ← ∩_def; exact ⟨x ∈ s, by { rw ← ∩_def; exact ⟨x ∈ s, by { rw ← ∩_def; exact ⟨x ∈ s⟩ }⟩ }⟩ }⟩ }⟩ }⟩ }⟩ }⟩ }⟩ }⟩
    exact ⟨x ∈ t, by { rw ← ∪_def; exact ⟨x ∈ t, by { rw ← ∩_def; exact ⟨x ∈ s, by { rw ← ∩_def; exact ⟨x ∈ s, by { rw ← ∩_def; exact ⟨x ∈ s, by { rw ← ∩_def; exact ⟨x ∈ s, by { rw ← ∩_def; exact ⟨x ∈ s, by { rw ← ∩_def; exact ⟨x ∈ s⟩ }⟩ }⟩ }⟩ }⟩ }⟩ }⟩ }⟩ }⟩
    exact ⟨x ∈ u, by { rw ← ∪_def; exact ⟨x ∈ u, by { rw ← ∩_def; exact ⟨x ∈ s, by { rw ← ∩_def; exact ⟨x ∈ s, by { rw ← ∩_def; exact ⟨x ∈ s, by { rw ← ∩_def; exact ⟨x ∈ s, by { rw ← ∩_def; exact ⟨x ∈ s⟩ }⟩ }⟩ }⟩ }⟩ }⟩ }⟩ }
  exact ⟨x, this, this⟩

intros x hx
  cases hx with h1 h2
  · haveI := h1
    rw [Set.mem_inter, Set.mem_union]
    exact ⟨h1.1, h1.2, h2.1, h2.2⟩
  · haveI := h2
    rw [Set.mem_inter, Set.mem_union]
    exact ⟨h2.1, h2.2, h1.1, h1.2⟩
